'''Chandad''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] used to complement other ingredients such as [[Potato/Legends|potato]] and [[Ghoba rice]] in the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[mounder potato rice]]. It was a popular snack food on [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]].<ref name="FK">{{JournalCite|6|Finder's Fee}}</ref>
